fields.name: archived
fields.short: A boolean indicating whether the message is archived.

fields.name: associateWithContactId
fields.short: The ID of the contact with which this message should be associated.

fields.name: attachments
fields.short: An array of attachments included with the message, which can be files, locations, contacts, or other supported types.

fields.name: channelAccountId
fields.short: The identifier of the channel account associated with the message.

fields.name: channelId
fields.short: The identifier of the channel through which the message was sent.

fields.name: conversationsThreadId
fields.short: The identifier for the conversation thread to which this message belongs.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.short: The date and time when the message was created, in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: createdBy
fields.short: The identifier of the user or system that created the message.

fields.name: direction
fields.short: The direction of the message, either 'INCOMING' or 'OUTGOING'.

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.short: A string containing an error message, if applicable.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier for the message.

fields.name: inReplyToId
fields.short: The identifier of the message to which this message is a reply, if applicable.

fields.name: integrationIdempotencyId
fields.short: A unique identifier to ensure idempotency of the message within the integration.

fields.name: integrationThreadId
fields.short: A unique identifier for the thread within the integration.

fields.name: messageDirection
fields.short: The direction of the message, indicating whether it is 'INCOMING' or 'OUTGOING'.

fields.name: recipients
fields.short: An array of recipients of the message, each containing recipient details.

fields.name: richText
fields.short: The rich text content of the message, if available.

fields.name: senders
fields.short: An array of senders associated with the message, each containing sender details.

fields.name: statusType
fields.short: Valid status are SENT, FAILED, and READ

fields.name: subject
fields.short: The subject of the message, if applicable.

fields.name: text
fields.short: The plain text content of the message.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.short: The date and time when the message was created, in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: truncationStatus
fields.short: Indicates whether the message content is truncated.

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of the message, which is always 'MESSAGE'.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.short: The date and time when the message was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
